name: rust-axum
description: A self-operated Rust API server — Axum + Tokio + PostgreSQL + SQLx (compile-time checked queries) + serde.

notes.securityBoundary: The application layer is the only boundary. The trap specific to this axis is **extractor order and the scope of middleware layers**: attach the auth layer to only some routers instead of via `Router::route_layer` and the remaining routes open up unauthenticated. The authentication method is undecided, so it is a question to confirm
notes.serverCodeLocation: The API server in this repository. Its language differs from the frontend's, so shared types cross over through a language-neutral contract such as OpenAPI
notes.toolchain: **The toolchain splits from the frontend's** (cargo ↔ npm). Commands are taken per axis and the representative command is confirmed. Without SQLx offline mode (`.sqlx/`), the build needs a DB connection
notes.variants: There is no prebuilt pack — the guide takes the generation path. Other frameworks such as Actix Web are entered as user-defined
